name: code
title: Code with a highlighted line
shows: An editor pane with two tabs, eight lines of code, one highlighted line and a one-line note on the change below.
edit: Lines are spans with data-n (line number); tokens use .k keyword, .f function, .n number, .c comment. The first change is the line marked is-mark with the note as written; every other changed line carries its own note as data-note="..." (or opts.steps [{line, text}]). The chip is left as written.
loop: about 2.7 s a cycle: the highlight moves through three changed lines, the note naming each; the finished picture holds for at most 15% of the cycle; restarts when the pointer enters its card
